about: The Workbench icons of the Einstein drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). art/einstein.png is four of Einstein's own cards (res/large-A1, C3, E2 and F5.bmp, GPL 2 like the game) on a 64 x 64 grid. Einstein-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, put beside the drawer as Einstein.info; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's Einstein.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for COPYING.txt; Data.info is the res drawer's icon.
